messages:
Mia: Heads-up — I'm seeing a burst of ECC/Xid on us-east-1 GPU nodes (~8 distinct cards in last 10m). Jobs started failing with OOM + Xid 43. Logged at 2026-03-15 14:07 UTC. Anyone already triaging?
Jordan: Confirming, I saw similar in cluster-gpu-pool-3. Noticing increased kernel oops in dmesg on node gpu-us-east-12. I'll paste the snippets in a sec.
Sam: dropping quick log sample: `dmesg | grep -i Xid` shows repeated `Xid 43` and `GPU reset` messages across 4 nodes. Suspect either ECC ramp or driver churn.
Nikhil: Is this correlated with last week's driver rollout? We moved 525.60 -> 525.85 in us-east on Wednesday.
Mia: Good point — rollout history shows a partial batch that retried and left some nodes on mixed drivers. But some cards also have rising ECC counters independent of driver.
Jordan: Quick inventory check: affected nodes have BIOS revision 1.2.3 while green nodes are 1.2.5. Could be firmware sensitivity.
Sam: Proposed short-term: detect burst patterns and prevent scheduling to affected nodes. I suggest a Prometheus alert: increase(nvidia_gpu_xid_total[5m]) > 5 per region. If fire, set node cordon and drain GPUs with ECC > 1000.
Sam: Example alert rule to start from:
```yaml
groups:
- name: gpu-xid
  rules:
  - alert: GPUXidBurst
    expr: increase(nvidia_gpu_xid_total[5m]) > 5
    for: 1m
    labels:
      severity: high
    annotations:
      summary: "Xid burst in {{ $labels.region }}"
```
Nikhil: Also want a Grafana panel that shows per-card ECC count trend + last reset time. For automation we should compute a lightweight health score: `health = round( (ECC_norm * 0.6) + (Xid_rate_norm * 0.3) + (reset_age_norm * 0.1) )` scaled 0-100.
Mia: That health score is fine as a starting point. Thresholds I'd propose: >70 -> immediate drain+replace; 50-70 -> schedule reimage & monitor; <50 -> continue monitoring. We should validate with historic incidents.
Jordan: Operational note: draining Dedicated capacity triggers live migration fallback to on-demand; cost delta ~ $45/node/hr for heavy models. Flagging for finance.
Sam: I'll draft a one-page runbook: detection -> correlate `/var/log/nvidia/` + `dmesg` -> mark cards -> drain -> swap via rack rotation -> post-checks. Will include the exact commands.
OpsBot: Alert created: GPUXidBurst for cluster-us-east (rule id 1729).
Mia: Thanks. Sam, can you add the Prometheus rule and Grafana panel JSON to infra repo and open a PR? Tag @Jordan and @Nikhil for review.
Sam: Will open PR and include dashboard snippet + test query. ETA ~2h. PR link when ready.
Jordan: If we keep seeing trend after remediation, we should consider rolling back 525.85 -> 525.60 on a canary subset and check ECC deltas.
Nikhil: Agreed. Also add a temporary routing override to steer latency-sensitive traffic away from us-east to us-west until we stabilize.
Mia: I'll coordinate with product for customer-impact messaging if SLOs look at risk. Also starting an incidents postmortem thread after we stabilize.
Sam: PR: https://github.com/redwood/infra/pull/1234 (WIP, adding rule and panel).
Jordan: :thumbsup:
Mia: Thanks all — let's treat this as high priority. If anyone notices new nodes flaring, drop them here and don't re-enable scheduling until validated.
